meta.title: VNT — Custom design and development
meta.description: A design and development studio. We design and build the solution your business needs, from the need to the working system.

hero.title: We design and build the solution your business needs.
hero.subtitle: Systems, sites and tools made to measure.

services.title: We cover the whole path
services.intro: From the need to the working solution. Design, build and launch with the same team from start to finish.

items.title: Brand & design
items.description: Visual identity, design system and interface. Clickable prototypes so you can see and decide before we build.

items.title: Custom development
items.description: Sites, admin panels and internal tools. Fast, accessible and easy to maintain.

items.title: Getting it live
items.description: Domain, hosting, analytics and search. We hand it over running and documented.

items.title: Maintenance & improvements
items.description: We stay close: new features, speed work and support whenever you need it.

steps.title: We talk
steps.description: We learn about your business, how it works today and what the solution has to solve.

steps.title: You get the proposal
steps.description: Scope, timeline and price in writing before we start.

steps.title: We design and build
steps.description: We work in parallel and show you progress as it comes, so you can weigh in before we move on.

steps.title: We ship it
steps.description: We publish, measure and adjust. And we show you how to handle whatever you want to change yourself.
